T: Four houses. Four dinners. One very full couple.
D: A couple stuck in town on Christmas Day has to visit all four of their divorced parents.
P: Serve the snacks when the fog cancels every flight out of San Francisco.
S: Almonds, cashews and pretzels baked with rosemary, brown sugar and flaky salt
Roasted almonds, cashews and pretzels tossed with rosemary, brown sugar and salt, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, bagged up for the trip.
Brad's rough dad and brothers who wrestle in the yard

Bratwurst simmered in lager with onions, then grilled until charred, sliced into bites and served on toothpicks with hot mustard and the sticky beer onions. Slice 3 onions and put in a wide pan with 8 bratwurst, 375ml lager and 20g butter. Simmer gently for 15 minutes. Lift out the sausages and grill over high heat until charred all over. Keep boiling the onions until the liquid is gone and they turn sticky and golden. Slice the bratwurst into thick bites, spear with toothpicks and serve with the onions and hot mustard.
Mini beef pies with puff pastry tops and tomato sauce
Mini beef pies of mince, onion and gravy in shortcrust bases with puff lids, baked at 200C for 20 minutes, tomato sauce on top.
M: Brown sugar and Dijon glazed ham with potato salad and green beans

Leg ham scored and glazed with brown sugar, mustard and orange, baked at 180C for 45 minutes and basted often, with potato salad and green beans. Score a 3kg leg ham and glaze with 150g brown sugar, 2 tbsp Dijon and the juice of 2 oranges. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, basting often. Serve with potato salad of 1kg potatoes and 300g green beans.
the nativity play at the church with Brad as Joseph

Beef ragù simmered slowly with tomato and red wine, layered with lasagne sheets, béchamel and mozzarella, baked bubbling and rested before slicing. Brown 800g beef mince with an onion, carrot and 3 garlic cloves. Add 150ml red wine, 2 cans crushed tomatoes and oregano and simmer 2 hours. Melt 50g butter, stir in 50g flour, whisk in 600ml milk and simmer until thick, adding nutmeg and 50g parmesan. Layer ragù, 300g lasagne sheets and béchamel in a dish, finishing with béchamel and 200g mozzarella. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes and rest 20.
W: Sherry sponge, raspberry jelly, custard, cream and fresh raspberries
Sponge soaked in sherry, layered with raspberry jelly, custard and whipped cream, chilled overnight and topped with berries.
K: Cranberry and orange juice with honey rosemary syrup and frozen cranberries

Cranberry and fresh orange juice with rosemary honey syrup, topped with ginger ale over ice, with frozen cranberries and orange wheels floating on top. Simmer 3 tbsp honey with 100ml water and 2 rosemary sprigs for 3 minutes, then cool and remove the rosemary. In a big bowl, mix 750ml cranberry juice, 500ml fresh orange juice and the syrup. Add plenty of ice, 100g frozen cranberries and 2 sliced oranges. Top with 1L cold ginger ale just before serving and float a few rosemary sprigs on top.

steps.text: Score the ham skin and rind. Mix the brown sugar, Dijon and orange juice into a glaze and brush it over.
Bake at 180C, basting often, until the glaze is sticky and deep golden.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes until tender, adding the beans for the last few minutes. Drain, cool and toss with the mayonnaise.
Rest the ham for 10 minutes, then carve and serve with the potato salad.
Score the tofu blocks in a diamond pattern. Simmer the brown sugar, Dijon, orange juice and soy sauce into a glaze and brush it over.
Bake at 180C, basting often, until the glaze is sticky and deep golden.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes until tender, adding the beans for the last few minutes. Drain, cool and toss with the mayonnaise.
Rest the tofu for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with the potato salad.

s.note: Almonds, cashews and pretzels baked with rosemary, brown sugar and flaky salt
s.how: Toss 150g almonds, 150g cashews and 100g pretzels with oil, chopped rosemary, 2 tbsp brown sugar and flaky salt. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Bag them up for the trip that never happens.

s.note: Mini beef pies with puff pastry tops and tomato sauce
s.how: Cook 500g beef mince with an onion and 250ml stock until thick and cool. Line patty tins with 2 sheets shortcrust, fill, top with 2 sheets puff and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Squirt tomato sauce on top.

m.note: Brown sugar and Dijon glazed ham with potato salad and green beans

w.note: Sherry sponge, raspberry jelly, custard, cream and fresh raspberries
w.how: Cut a sponge cake into chunks in a bowl and drizzle with 60ml sweet sherry. Pour over a packet of raspberry jelly and set. Layer with 500ml custard and 300ml whipped cream and top with raspberries. Chill overnight.
